description:
Multiple CI workflows are failing due to broken configurations, missing files,
and duplicate workflows. This task addresses all critical issues to achieve
green CI builds on GitHub.

Issues identified in code review:
1. tpch-c-compatible-tests.yml references non-existent scripts
2. python-publish.yml duplicates release.yml functionality
3. docs.yml has failing linkcheck job
4. test.yml has duplicate docs job
5. Test matrix is overly broad (13 configurations)
